about: The Napkin house style and the radio quality gate, as data. Ported by hand from larryob78/napkin-radio at e1317fd (lib/ai/house-style.ts, lib/radio/quality.ts, lib/radio/parse.ts): the rules are rewritten here, not copied. The page reads it for its live check and lists findings; it never changes a person's words. The rewrite handlers (not built yet) read the same file. The 0 to 1 score and the 0.7 pass mark of the source are not ported: the editor lists what it finds and passes or fails nobody. Licence: the source repo has no licence file; the product owner has approved the port and the written confirmation is still open (features/script-editor.clan).

system_fragment: Write like a senior creative at a good agency: plain, confident, specific. Never use an em dash or an en dash; use a comma, a full stop, or rewrite. Avoid the words and phrases in this file's house_phrases. No stacked hype adjectives, no hedging, no throat-clearing openers, no sign-offs. Lead with the point, keep sentences short, prefer concrete nouns and strong verbs, vary the rhythm, and write in the active voice.

advice.mandatory_missing: Not in the script yet. Write it in, word for word where the brief says so.
advice.banned_word: On the list of words not to use for this job.
advice.house_phrase: House style: a stock phrase. Say it plainer.
advice.dash: House style: no em or en dash. A comma or a full stop does the same work.
advice.meta_phrase: Reads like a template or a chat reply, not copy.
advice.stage_direction: A stage direction sits inside a spoken line. Give it a line of its own as SFX or MUSIC.
advice.repetition: Lines or phrases repeat. Read it aloud and cut what loops.
advice.length_off: The words do not fit the slot.
advice.length_long: Too many words for the slot. Cut until it reads in time.
advice.length_short: Well short of the slot. There is room for more words, or a held pause.
advice.cast_count: The number of voices is not the number the brief asks for.
